steps.content: You finally make your way forward and grab Hella's hand.
She shakes off your hand and looks at you with an terrified expression you've never seen. Hella disappears into the crowd, screaming.
Hecate's anxious voice comes from behind. To protect you from getting trampled by the procession, the Nightmare is trying its best to drag you out of the crowd.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella... She's just been captured by the illusion.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She didn't mean to do that to you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let's go after her and take her back.

steps.content: You can still make it. You must catch up with her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But Chief... Can we still catch up with her?

steps.speaker: Bunny Mascot
steps.content: Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome! Welcome—!
Confetti is flying in the sky, and the bunny mascot is still beating the drum on its chest mechanically.
The old man draped in the tattered flag is still sitting on the steps at the Carnival's gate.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Go away, the park is not for humans, you'll only get lost if you stay...

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Lost on the way to see her, and you'll never get to see her...
This is Hamel's power. This is the <color=#fb9259>Endless Carnival</color>. You can't even get close to her, let alone defeat the Ring's owner.
